what_happened: The whole LCExtension module skeleton (RuleSet, IsLCAxiom/IsLCUAxiom with their ZTime-validity lemmas, the ten-constructor ExtDerivation inductive, and ext_sound_ztime proved by induction with all nine non-trivial cases closing) elaborated green under lean_run_code on the first corrected attempt, seeded from the archived 879 probe specs/879_lplus_ztime_completeness_tm_plus_lc_programme/probes/01_target-statements.lean. Only two fixes were needed against that archived probe: the plus_soundness_ztime namespace (FormalSystem.Metalogic.Conservativity) and re-encoding the two naming-rule constructors from the probe's List Atom shape to the landed aaAnte qa m k a p b0 shape.

The task's declared file_scope (LCExtension.lean, Metalogic.lean, FormalSystem.lean, docs/theorem-index.md) is two paths short of what the repo's own invariants require: C27 forbids a live #print axioms under FormalSystem/, so the axiom-profile pins must live in Tests/BimodalTest/Metalogic/LCExtensionTest.lean, which in turn needs an import line in the hand-maintained Tests/BimodalTest.lean. Recorded as a plan-phase obligation rather than worked around; the alternative (a pinned:C14 theorem-index cell) would pull scripts/check-module-invariants.sh into scope instead, which is worse.

The archived probe specs/879_lplus_ztime_completeness_tm_plus_lc_programme/probes/01_target-statements.lean, which the task description's shapes were drafted from, has drifted against the tree on two points since it was written: it redefines lcU locally (lcU is now library API in PlusLanguage/PlusLCSchema.lean with four validity theorems attached) and its two naming-rule constructors use a Q : List Atom / p : Atom -> Nat -> Atom encoding that the landed aaAnte (qa : Nat -> Atom) (m k) (a) (p : Nat -> Nat -> Nat) (b0 : Nat) does not have. A verbatim transcription would not compile. Superseded by probes/01_lcextension-skeleton.lean, whose header records the supersession.

Plan-authoring dispatch compiled the plan's ## Lean Challenge Statements block standalone with 'lake env lean' (exit 0, only 'declaration uses sorry' warnings), which also verified the exact three-line import list Phase 1 needs (Metalogic.AuxiliaryAtoms, Metalogic.Conservativity.Plus.PlusSoundness, PlusLanguage.PlusReversal) instead of the probe's blanket 'import FormalSystem'.

The research report's territory paragraph judged README.md, FormalSystem/README.md, FormalSystem/Metalogic/README.md and typst/generated/status.typ 'not needed' for this task. Verified otherwise at plan time: .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit staging a .lean file while typst/generated/status.typ is count-stale, and check-module-invariants.sh's INV check fails on the generated inventory blocks covering dir=FormalSystem and dir=FormalSystem/Metalogic once a new loose .lean file lands there. The plan declares all four, plus the two Tests/ paths the report did name, taking the declared file scope from four paths to ten.

Phase 1 landed first-try green: the research dispatch's verified probe plus the plan's compiled three-import list meant LCExtension.lean built with zero errors and zero warnings on the first scoped build, no tactic iteration at all.

Plan's Phase 1 Files-to-modify said to place FormalSystem.lean's new import beside import FormalSystem.Metalogic.AuxiliaryAtoms; that file is alphabetically sorted, so the import went at its alphabetical position (line 506, between Independence.ZTimeSharpness and NamingRules) instead. Placement recorded per the plan's own 'record the placement' instruction.

All six measured axiom profiles matched the plan's carried ceiling [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] exactly, including ext_sound_validIn which the research report had verified green but not reported a profile for. BimodalTest built green first try, so no guard needed adjusting.
